name: usage-guard
description: Near a plan usage limit, every session saves its work and stops background jobs, then work resumes on its own after the limit resets.

wrapUpAt.title: Wrap up at (% used)
wrapUpAt.description: When any plan window (5-hour, weekly) reaches this percentage, sessions wrap up. The rest is left for the wrap-up itself and for CI jobs already running.

wakeDelayMinutes.title: Resume delay (minutes)
wakeDelayMinutes.description: How long after the limit resets the sessions resume work.

compactAbovePercent.title: Compact before a pause above (% context)
compactAbovePercent.description: A session that will resume on its own compacts after its wrap-up when its context is above this share and the reset is more than an hour away, so the resume starts from a summary instead of reading the whole context with a cold cache. 0 turns it off.

catchUpMinutes.title: Catch up a missed resume (minutes)
catchUpMinutes.description: A session armed to resume that was closed at its wake resumes when it starts again within this many minutes of the wake. Later, it only says what it missed. 0 never catches up.
